description: POST /{WABA-ID}/message_templates models its components from one example (an OTP template with a FLOW button): a component has only `type`, `text` and `buttons`, and a button only `type`, `text`, `flow_id`, `flow_action` and `navigate_screen`. Templates take more (https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview). Live on 2026-11-18 (v23.0) a UTILITY template with a `HEADER` (`format: TEXT`, `example: { header_text }`), a `BODY` (`example: { body_text }`) and `BUTTONS` holding a `URL` button (`url`, `example`) and a `PHONE_NUMBER` button (`phone_number`) was created, and GET /{TEMPLATE_ID} returned every one of those members as sent. A component gains `format` and `example`; a button gains `url`, `phone_number` and `example`. `example` stays a document: its shape depends on the component (`header_text`, `body_text`, `header_handle`) and the button type.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Sample values for the component's variables, e.g. `{ header_text: ["A-123"] }` or `{ body_text: [["Ana", "A-123"]] }`.
`URL` button target; may end in one `{{1}}` variable.
`PHONE_NUMBER` button: the number to call, in international format.
Sample values for the button's variable, e.g. `["https://example.com/o/A-123"]` for a `URL` button.
